items.claim: Lizz is on his way out and essentially done as a fighter at this point.
items.quote: I think Deli is kind of on his way out. I think Lizz's kind of done at this point.

items.claim: Deli has high confidence in his jiu-jitsu and is willing to pull guard or roll for legs.
items.quote: Deli is very confident in his jiu-jitsu. He'll pull guard. He'll roll for a leg.

items.claim: Deli has a 32% takedown defense success rate.
Derritter will have no problem taking Deli down.
items.quote: Derritter should have no problem taking him down.

items.claim: Derritter is on another level when it comes to grappling compared to his opponent.
items.quote: He's on another level when it comes to the grappling.

items.claim: Jax McVey will finish Wes Schultz early in the fight, potentially by knockout or submission.
items.quote: I think he puts it on Wes Schultz. I think the party's over. Could be KO, could be sub, but I think if it comes, it comes early.
